title: bwrk capture - global inbox from any cwd
description: WHY: discoveries die in whatever repo you were standing in because capture currently requires a workspace and a destination. WHAT: bwrk capture <text> [--label ...] [--uri <ref>] writes a raw inbox record into the global workspace vault regardless of cwd - inside a project workspace, outside any workspace, anywhere. Reuse the existing raw source machinery (global workspace memory raw tree and the raw record contracts) rather than inventing a parallel store; the only new behavior is workspace selection (always global for capture) and zero-prompt speed - capture must be one command with no questions asked. If the global registry does not exist, surface the standard first-run bootstrap from sprint G2 rather than a bespoke error. Register the command with usage; add bwrk capture --list as a thin alias for listing the global raw inbox.
acceptanceCriteria: capture works from inside a project workspace, from a non-Boreal directory, and appends to the global raw inbox in both cases
Captured items appear via the global raw list surface with labels and optional uri preserved
